summary: The agent sets up a K-Fold cross-validation pipeline with CatBoost, utilizing its built-in text and categorical feature support. However, it inappropriately computes imputation statistics (median) on the test set separately, ignores temporal ordering despite having a 'reportYear' feature, and naively averages predictions across folds without tuning the ensemble weights. Additionally, no hyperparameter tuning is performed.
